raw_site_text: 4 large cities in South Africa (Cape Town, Durban/eThekwini, Johannesburg, and Pretoria/Tshwane)
justification: Cohorts were trained in Cape Town, Durban, Johannesburg and Pretoria, which lie in Western Cape, KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng.
note: Johannesburg and Pretoria are both in Gauteng.
